scope: Corollary 10.1 (Fixed almost-embeddable families) of the manuscript “Planar Graph Metrics Embed into L1 with Constant Distortion” (preprints/Planar-Graph-Metrics-Embed-into-L1-with-Constant-Distortion-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 089 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 11b3a102e7333bf8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix nonnegative integers g, k, w, a, and interpret AE(g, (k, w), a) exactly as the almost-embeddable family of Lee and Sidiropoulos [13, Theorem 1.7]. Let h0 = h0(g, k, w, a) ∈ N0 be the target treewidth bound and let D = D(g, k, w, a) ≥ 1 be a finite stochastic distortion bound supplied there. Put b h = max{h0, 1}, K(g, k, w, a) = D max{Cpl, Cb h+1 }, where Cpl is the constant of Theorem 1.1, and Ct is the companion’s constant for bags of cardinality at most t ≥ 2. Every finite connected simple graph G in this named family, with strictly positive real edge lengths, admits a map f into a real L1 space satisfying dG(u, v) ≤ ∥f(u) − f(v)∥1 ≤ K(g, k, w, a)dG(u, v) (u, v ∈ V (G)). For the same underlying graph, K(g, k, w, a) also bounds the undirected fractional concurrent flow–cut gap ϕ∗/λ∗ for the finite nonnegative capacities and demands defined in Section 1.1, whenever λ∗ > 0.
